verdict.rationale: Every Supabase project is provisioned as a full managed Postgres database with auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs and scalable compute. The API-key model explicitly covers client use (publishable key, limited by RLS) and server use (secret key). Official per-language SDK reference corpora (JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python, C#) and generated database types support client and server access, and community users report building many production backends on the hosted database. Missing for 10: explicit first-party SDK read/write code examples in the evidence, and hands-on corroboration of SDK queries against a provisioned project.
